title: MetaSkill: Reusable Problem-Solving Methods for Adaptive Skill Orchestration in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.29274v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reusable skills provide specialized procedures, but large language model (LLM) agents must still determine how to organize and adapt their use. We introduce MetaSkill, a two-layer framework for reusing problem-solving methods across tasks and domains. The method layer selects from 26 curated methods and binds abstract roles to task objects. The execution layer uses the instantiated method to identify intermediate objectives, coordinate native skills, and guide repair or method reselection. On 89 SkillsBench tasks and 995 ToolHop examples, MetaSkill outperforms the evaluated baselines in all six configurations, with accuracy gains of 3.51-13.48% over the strongest baseline. Ablations support explicit method-guided orchestration beyond direct method injection and further gains from method reselection.

translated_title: MetaSkill：面向LLM智能体自适应技能编排的可复用问题解决方法
translated_abstract: 可复用技能提供了专门化的操作流程，但大语言模型（LLM）智能体仍需自行决定如何组织和调整这些技能的使用。我们提出了MetaSkill，一个跨任务、跨领域复用问题解决方法的双层框架。方法层从26个精选方法中进行选择，并将抽象角色绑定到任务对象上。执行层利用实例化的方法来识别中间目标、协调原生技能，并引导修复或方法重选。在89个SkillsBench任务和995个ToolHop示例上，MetaSkill在全部六种配置中均优于所评估的基线方法，相比最强基线准确率提升3.51%-13.48%。消融实验表明，显式的方法引导编排优于直接方法注入，且方法重选能带来进一步提升。
tldr: MetaSkill提出一个双层框架，通过选择并实例化可复用的问题解决方法来引导LLM智能体自适应地编排技能，在SkillsBench和ToolHop基准上相比最强基线准确率提升3.51%-13.48%。
